If you thought high-speed gorilla locomotion was purely about frantic multiplayer games and swinging through trees, Gorilla Tag Horror Remastered will completely shift your perspective—right after it makes you leap out of your skin.  
The Verdict
Gorilla Tag Horror Remastered takes the brilliant, momentum-based, arm-only locomotion of the original formula and drops it directly into a nightmare. The "Remastered" tag isn't just window dressing: it delivers punchier visuals, darker environmental lighting, sharper sound design, and genuine adrenaline-pumping tension.  
What Works Great
 Terrifying Skill-Based Locomotion: There are no analog sticks or panic-teleport buttons to save you—you survive purely on how fast and accurately you can propel yourself using your own arms. When you hear something lurking in the pitch-black hallways, running for your life becomes a genuine physical workout.  
 Atmosphere & Sound Design: The revamped lighting and restrictive field-of-view force you to rely heavily on spatial audio. Hearing distant footfalls or eerie ambient creaks echoing through tight crawlspaces creates an incredible sense of claustrophobia.
 Heart-Pounding Chase Sequences: The enemy AI forces you to make split-second navigation choices. Missing a surface bounce or hitting a wall during a close-range pursuit often means game over, making every escape feel earned and thrilling.
 Pure VR Immersion: Standalone VR games rarely hit this sweet spot between active physical movement and horror. It captures the chaotic fun of Gorilla Tag while tapping into pure survival instincts.  
Things to Keep in Mind
Because the movement is fast-paced and physical, ensure you have plenty of room-scale space clear around you—you will accidentally swat a wall or lamp if you panic! Comfort-wise, it requires moderate VR legs since sudden launches and quick wall-bounces can trigger motion sensitivity for VR beginners.  
Final Score: 4.6 / 5
Whether you’re jumping in solo or braving the dark with friends, Gorilla Tag Horror Remastered is easily one of the most exciting horror experiences available on App Lab. Download it, turn the lights off, and get ready to run!
